fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Miami hosting major conventions (Shrine and Elks), civic hospitality and publicity, and local government matters. Coverage addresses Coral Gables Corporation financial troubles and their perceived impact on Florida real estate and investor confidence, city dock rental negotiations, and complaints about local streetcar and bus transportation service. Additional pieces discuss regulation and conditions in local businesses (dry cleaners, printers), Prohibition-era liquor availability and pricing, traffic enforcement, and assorted local notes, letters to the editor, and entertainment listings.
